messages:
elaine: Quick async: need to finalize minimal packaging + upgrade lane decisions for private onramp. Keep it tight.
jasper: Short list: installer profiles (minimal vs ops), preflight checks, rollback policy, console vs CLI first.
maria: Field: pilots want a minimal installer (no relay) and an ops installer (relay + support hooks). Also need a copy-paste allowlist for NetOps.
frank: Runtime constraints: minor semver bumps = rolling operator upgrades (short drain), major = explicit migration. KV cache compatibility only for minors.
jasper: Proposal: CLI-first alpha with two profiles: minimal and ops. Preflight should validate egress/DNS/TLS and fail with suggested remediation.
netops: We'll draft a one-page allowlist snippet + a curl-based egress test. Security to review wording.
maria: Upgrade policy from field: staged canary (1 node or 5% tenants) + automatic revert on error spike; manual revert token as backup.
frank: I'll prototype revert token and a short runbook for major migrations.
deploy-bot: Created Jira RDW-ONRAMP-12 for "minimal/ops installer + preflight".
elaine: Actions: jasper - installer templates + preflight checks (1w); frank - revert token + runbook (2w); maria - recruit 2 pilots (2w); netops - allowlist snippet (1w). Flag blockers here. :thumbsup:
